cars.summary: The third RS 3 Sportback pairs Audi’s distinctive five-cylinder engine with the brand’s first RS torque splitter. Independently controlled rear clutches mark a substantial handling-development landmark within this established performance-hatch lineage, rather than another trim or an extra sedan-body count.
